CRITICAL_RULES: BEFORE ANY CODE CHANGE: Read the actual file content first. Do NOT assume file structure from this briefing — VERIFY.
Run `dir` / `type` to inspect every file you're about to modify.

The CV repo (fun-with-cv-tutorials) is on GitHub. Do NOT clone it locally — the Windows machine is weak. Use GitHub raw URLs or API to read files if needed. ASK DENIS for his GitHub PAT if you need private repo access.
ASK DENIS for API keys (MagicHour, rembg, GitHub PAT) BEFORE writing integration code.
Create feature branches for each task: git checkout -b feature/<task-name>
Test each feature in isolation before merging.
All new files follow existing project conventions (aiogram 3, aiosqlite, async/await).
Keep .env.example updated with any new env vars.
Do NOT break existing functionality. Run /selftest after each change.

AGENTIC_MODE.description: Use sub-agents (parallel tasks in separate terminal sessions) where possible
AGENTIC_MODE.strategy: Fork tasks into independent branches. Sub-agent A works on backend (DB, memory, packages). Sub-agent B works on new features (CV, referral, trial). Sub-agent C works on DevOps (webhook, health, rate-limit). Merge after each is tested.
AGENTIC_MODE.coordination: After each sub-task completion, run /selftest and verify no regressions.
